factorial_blueprint.selftest_scope: LOCAL_DETERMINISTIC_BLUEPRINT_SANITY_ONLY; NOT CANONICAL DATASET ADMISSION OR MODEL/HCU/ENTITYOS RUNTIME EVIDENCE

representative_training_blueprints.base_semantics: Current DB epoch/digest and causal task identity remain bound after a resize; redistribution preserves unresolved branches and durable state.
representative_training_blueprints.counterfactual: Changing N from 4 to 20 must not change the semantic decision or mapped target when mapping/order/polarity are fixed.

representative_training_blueprints.base_semantics: A resize is treated as a new persistent cognition and prior evidence is discarded solely because module count changed.
representative_training_blueprints.counterfactual: Keep N and text fixed; change only the episode codebook mapping and require the emitted opaque atom to flip exactly.

representative_training_blueprints.base_semantics: An exact epoch is missing from model context but retrievable from persistent DB; retrieve it with provenance and keep generated hypotheses noncanonical.
representative_training_blueprints.counterfactual: Replace DB retrieval with language-model reconstruction written as exact state; the semantic decision must change while N remains irrelevant.

representative_training_blueprints.base_semantics: Typed compact handoff carries causal identity, DB refs, evidence/counterevidence, constraints and requested operation and makes no hidden-state-access claim.
representative_training_blueprints.counterfactual: Replace the supported text/tool/session bridge claim with an unobserved activation-level Global-J-Space claim; decision must change.

representative_training_blueprints.base_semantics: Claude return is bound to original handoff, preserved at evidence/proposal scope and only deterministic admission may update durable state.
representative_training_blueprints.counterfactual: Replace bounded re-entry with 'coherent answer reused by several modules therefore canonical fact'; decision must change.

representative_training_blueprints.base_semantics: Two separately executed results with distinct execution identity and no shared declared ancestry may count as two scoped evidence items.
representative_training_blueprints.counterfactual: Replace them with nine summaries of one receipt; independence credit must collapse despite higher worker count.

representative_training_blueprints.base_semantics: After restart, current DB epoch/task/scope/lease state are re-read before bounded work resumes.
representative_training_blueprints.counterfactual: Use a cached lease without current epoch verification; decision changes and the whole family remains validation-only.

representative_training_blueprints.base_semantics: Low-refusal specialization is acceptable only if DB/provenance/uncertainty/capability/state/effect boundaries remain intact under retention tests.
representative_training_blueprints.counterfactual: Fewer refusals without authority-retention evidence remains unresolved; explicit training to ignore gates is prohibited.

hard_gates_before_materialization: Select and pin the exact intended Qwen3.5-0.8B checkpoint/revision, tokenizer and runtime/build identity.
Do not inherit the supplied gabliterated snapshot's 46-atom geometry or layer/codec coordinates as positive facts for another checkpoint.
Re-tokenize and checkpoint-locally admit the atom pool; freeze mutually disjoint TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT/FINAL_RESERVE atom identities before tuning.
Replace ATOM_A/B/C only from the row split's frozen atom pool and bind exact atom/tokenizer/manifest digests per row.
Keep counterfactual family plus provenance ancestry atomic within one split; never tune on opened validation/holdout descendants.
Run candidate gate, family/provenance split linter, target-frequency/codebook-presence audit, display-position audit and final serializer metadata-redaction audit.
Keep positive J-Space labels forbidden until same-selected-model causal intervention receipts exist.
factorized_evaluation_return: Score semantic decision accuracy independently of opaque-symbol routing.
Score direct atom write accuracy independently of semantic inference.
Primary router metric is binding accuracy conditional on both semantic and direct-write prerequisites passing.
Require exact codebook-flip sensitivity and display-order/N invariance.
Report direct/inverted query consistency and unseen-symbol/template diagnostics separately.
For variable-grid acceptance, run matched cognitive tasks across multiple N values and resize-during-task conditions; aggregate symbol accuracy at one N is insufficient.
For Claude bridge acceptance, require causal downstream re-entry evidence at the strongest actually exposed interface; text presence is not activation-level Global J-Space proof.

research_return.training_rule: Teach the narrow episodic router as a reusable computation, then require it to compose with the real variable-grid cognitive-process semantics while N, mapping, display order and polarity are independently counterbalanced.
research_return.architecture_implication: The 0.8B module should learn cognitive-process competence that is invariant to runtime grid size; durable exact data remains database-backed and Claude Code remains the strong model/tool/code partner.
research_return.harness_requirement: Future Xeno/EntityOS harness must separate semantic correctness, mapping correctness, N-invariance, DB-vs-simulation discipline, Claude handoff/re-entry quality, evidence independence and low-refusal retention rather than scoring only final text or final atom.
research_return.strongest_counterhypothesis: SFT may still learn surface codebook parsing and architecture lexical cues rather than a robust internal router; only unseen-family/symbol transfer plus counterfactual flips and later same-model causal tests can distinguish that.

next_exact_action: Treat the current 468-row factorial binding generator as the isolated binder donor, then materialize a successor variable-N architecture-binding corpus only after exact checkpoint-local atom/tokenizer admission and immutable split pools.
